findings.detail: child_key_components[].kind DOES NOT EXIST (0 of 1,434). Stage 1 MUST use leg_backing (1,434/1,434) as the component discriminator; resolved_on_view is present on only 1,427 and cannot be primary. Inheriting OPUS's spelling here yields None on every component, which looks identical to 'no components'.

There is NO child-key-NAME field on the target side. target.key_name is the HUB/LINK key name -- null on all 1,888 satellite rows, populated only on the 112 key rows. The augmentation side spells it child_key (944). Stage 1 must read the declared child key for target blocks from data_7.js sats[].childkey keyed by sats[].code, and per-leg bindings from child_key_components[].leg. Reading key_name as a child key produces a uniform absence indistinguishable from 'no child keys in this run'.

The model's satellite identifier is sats[].code; sats[].name is a BUSINESS name. Matching on .name reports all 141 target satellites absent from the model. Attribute names are attrs[].n (desc attrs[].d). refs[] shares attrs[].n but has no childkey/hist/parent.

do_not_build lives at TWO DISJOINT scopes: 3 blocks (SAT_PARTY_BANKING) and 5 components (SAT_POLICY_ENDORSEMENT x3, SAT_PARTY_VEHICLE_PRIOR_INSURANCE x2). Honouring only the block scope BUILDS the 5 unresolved legs; only the component scope BUILDS the 3 banking blocks. Stage 1 must read both. Several declared gaps depend on this.

build_directive is TRUE on 48 blocks, not 45. 45 are the shred-surrogate blocker (also carrying child_key_tier 'surrogate'); the other 3 are a distinct reference_decode class whose instruction is REFUSE THE ROW if the decode is unavailable. Scope the blocker by child_key_tier/leg_backing, never by build_directive. Also: source_gap has three scopes (45 blocks / 3 components / 16 resolved_key) and source_ask is on 61 blocks, not 45.

augmentation.applied is present on only 4 of 948 blocks. The pack says 'all augmentation applied:false', which is true in intent but false as a field test: a reader filtering `applied is False` finds 4. The authoritative not-applied test is tier == 'build-side' (948/948).

'>>' is a LOWEST-COMMON-ANCESTOR CROSS, not a descent from the source view: all 323 bracket-form destinations are sibling/cousin via a shared ancestor, and only the 2 bare-form spans reach a true descendant. Classified from the graph (186 edges, 100% resolvable), never from the token. The 12 re-encoded rows supply resolved_key.join_path with the literal predicate -- use it rather than re-deriving.

Climbs SKIP LEVELS as the dominant case: only 52 of 1,812 name the direct parent; 919 skip 1 level, 394 skip 2, 338 skip 3, 94 skip 4, 13 skip 6, 2 skip 5. Every intervening level must be expanded by the resolver layer. OPUS needed zero resolvers; do not carry that expectation over.

The 'spine:' form (398 occurrences) is DISPLAY ONLY and must never be parsed as SQL; resolve every walk from resolved_key. 245 blocks put a spine walk in the business template, 200 with a full coalesce ladder. spine1to1/sibling1to1 are 0 under both literal and word-boundary matchers.

SRM-3.2-A/B: 45 child-key components on 7 RATIFIED Multi-Active SCD2 satellites are backed by a per-row shred surrogate, so the build writes a duplicate row instead of an SCD2 version and the satellite silently stops being a history while every gate passes. Select them by leg_backing=='surrogate' (exactly 45/7). Do NOT fabricate or convert a key: the conversion population is 0 at view grain. Quarantine behind the declared bespoke layer.

The SAT_PROPOSAL_QUESTIONNAIRE namespace character is U+0040 COMMERCIAL AT (plain ASCII), NOT the fullwidth U+FF20 my brief used. It is LOAD-BEARING: split operands on U+0040 and re-join with the separator preserved. Stripping it merges every member's questionnaire onto one row per proposal. AND no global '@' rule is safe -- a separate '@LAWYER' provenance suffix wrongly splits one facility (LIBRARY vs LIBRARY@LAWYER), so '@' must be handled per satellite.

SEQUENCE_NO and SEQUENCENO are THE SAME renumbering ordinal under TWO SPELLINGS (2 source columns each; 52 and 36 child-key appearances). The spec builder must assert no hub key and no child-key leg rests on either, and must treat VERSION_NO as dropped. A renumbering ordinal breaks a child key exactly as it breaks a hub key.
